text: Suraton ke awal jo Huroof-e-Muqatta'at aaye hain un ka bayan pehle guzar chuka hai. Ayat mein Quran ki aayton ke wazeh aur har shakhs ki samajh mein aane ke qabil hone ka bayan farmaya hai.

Ba'd az marg peshimani, kafir apne kufr par anqarib nadim o peshiman honge aur musalmaan ban kar zindagi guzarne ki tamanna karenge. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke kuffar-e-Badr jab jahannam ke samne pesh kiye jayenge, aarzu karenge ke kaash ke woh duniya mein momin hote. Yeh bhi hai ke har kafr apni maut ko dekh kar apne musalmaan hone ki tamanna karta hai. Isi tarah Qiyamat ke din bhi har kafir ki yahi tamanna hogi. Jahannam ke paas khade ho kar kahenge ke kaash ke ab hum waapas duniya mein bhej diye jayenge toh na toh Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlayenge na tark-e-iman karenge. Jahannami log auron ko jahannam se nikalte dekh kar bhi apne musalmaan hone ki tamanna karenge. 

Ibn Abbas aur Anas bin Malik R.A farmate hain ke gunahgaar musalmanon ko jahannam mein mushrikon ke saath Allah Ta'ala rok lega toh mushrik un musalmanon se kahenge ke jis Allah ki tum duniya mein ibaadat karte rahe usne tumhe aaj kya fayda diya? Is par Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat ko josh aayega aur un musalmanon ko jahannam se nikaal lega, us waqt kafir tamanna karenge ke kaash woh bhi duniya mein musalmaan hote. 

Ek riwayat mein hai ke mushrikon ke is taane par Allah Ta'ala hukum dega ke jis ke dil mein ek zarre ke barabar bhi iman ho use jahannam se aazad kar do, al-kh. 

Tabarani mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain: La ilaha illallah ke kehne walon mein ba'z log ba-sabab apne gunahon ke jahannam mein jayenge, pas Laat o Uzza ke pujari unse kahenge ke tumhare La ilaha illallah kehne ne tumhe kya nafa diya? Tum toh hamare saath hi jahannam mein jal rahe ho. Is par Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat ko josh aayega, Allah un sab ko wahan se nikaal lega aur Nahr-e-Hayat mein ghota de kar unhe aisa kar dega jaise chand gahan se nikla ho. Phir yeh sab Jannat mein jayenge, wahan unhe jahannami kaha jayega. 

Hazrat Anas R.A se yeh hadith sun kar kisi ne kaha kya aap ne ise Rasool Allah ﷺ ki zubaani suna hai? Aap ne farmaya suno main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai ke mujh par qasdan jhoot bolne wala apni jagah jahannam mein bana le. Bawajood iske main kehta hoon ke main ne yeh hadith khud Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ ki zubaani suni hai. 

Aur riwayat mein hai ke mushrik log Ahl-e-Qibla se kahenge ke tum toh musalmaan the phir tumhe Islam ne kya nafa diya? Tum toh hamare saath jahannam mein jal rahe ho. Woh jawab denge ke hamare gunah the jin ki padaash mein hum pakde gaye, al-kh. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke unke chhutkare ke waqt kuffar kahenge ke kaash hum musalmaan hote aur unki tarah jahannam se chhutkara paate. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne ayat (A'uzubillahi minash shaitanir rajeem) padh kar shuru soorat se Muslimeen tak tilawat farmayi. 

Yahi riwayat aur sanad se hai is mein a'uzu ke badle ayat (Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem) ka padhna hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke un musalmaan gunahgaaron se mushrikeen kahenge ke tum toh duniya mein yeh khayal karte the ke tum Awliyaullah ho phir hamare saath yahan kaise? Yeh sun kar Allah Ta'ala unki shafa'at ki ijazat dega.

Pas farishte aur nabi aur momin shafaat karenge aur Allah unhein jahannam se chhor diya jayega us waqt mushrik log kahenge ke kash woh bhi musalman hote toh shafaat se mahrom na rehte aur un ke sath jahannam se chhoot jate. Yehi maana is ayat ke hain yeh log jab jannat mein jayenge toh un ke chehron par qadray siyahi hogi is wajah se unhein jahannami kaha jata hoga. Phir yeh dua karenge ke اے اللہ yeh laqab bhi hum se hata de pas unhein jannat ki ek nehar mein ghusal karne ka hukm hoga aur woh naam bhi un se door kar diya jayega. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain baaz logon ko aag un ke ghutnon tak pakad legi aur baaz ko zanon tak aur baaz ko gardan tak jaise jin ke gunah aur jaise jin ke aamal honge. Baaz ek mahine ki saza bhugat kar nikal ayenge sab se lambi saza wala woh hoga jo jahannam mein itni muddat rahega jitni muddat duniya ki hai yani duniya ke pehle din se duniya ke aakhri din tak. Jab un ke nikalne ka irada Allah Ta'ala kar lega us waqt Yahood-o-Nasara aur doosre deen wale jahannami un ahl-e-tauheed se kahenge ke tum Allah par us ki kitabon par us ke rasoolon par iman laye thay phir bhi aaj hum aur tum jahannam mein yaksan hain. Pas Allah Ta'ala ko sakht ghussa ayega ke un ki aur kisi baat par itna ghussa na aya tha phir un muwahideen ko jahannam se nikal kar jannat ki nehar ke pas laya jayega. Yeh hai farman ayat (Rubama yawaddul-lazeena kafaru law kanu muslimeen) (Al-Hijr: 2) mein hai. Phir ba-taur dant ke farmata hai ke unhein khate peete aur maze karte chhor de aakhir toh un ka thikana jahannam hai. Tum kha pi lo, tumhara mujrim hona sabit ho chuka hai. Unhein un ki door daraz ki khwahishen tauba karne se, Allah ki taraf jhukne se ghafil rakhengi. Anqareeb haqeeqat khul jayegi. Itmam-e-hujjat ke baad hum kisi basti ko daleelen pahunchane aur un ka muqarrar waqt khatam hone se pehle halak nahi karte. Han jab waqt-e-muqarrar ajata hai phir taqdeem-o-taakheer namumkin hai is mein ahl-e-Makkah ki tanbeeh hai ke woh shirq se ilhad se Rasool Allah ﷺ ki mukhalifat se baaz ajayen warna mustahiq-e-halakat ho jayenge aur apne waqt par tabah ho jayenge.

Han jab waqt-e-muqarrar ajata hai phir taqdeem-o-taakheer namumkin hai is mein ahl-e-Makkah ki tanbeeh hai ke woh shirq se ilhad se Rasool Allah ﷺ ki mukhalifat se baaz ajayen warna mustahiq-e-halakat ho jayenge aur apne waqt par tabah ho jayenge.

Sarkash-o-mutakabbir halak honge. Kafiron ka kufr, unki sarkashi, takbar aur zid ka bayan ho raha hai ke woh ba-taur mazak aur hansi ke Rasool Allah ﷺ se kehte thay ke ae woh shakhs jo is baat ka mudda'i hai ke tujh par Quran Allah ka kalam utar raha hai, hum toh dekhte hain ke tu sarasar pagal hai jo apni tab'adari ki taraf humein bula raha hai aur hum se keh raha hai ke hum apne baap dadaon ke deen ko chhod dein. Agar sacha hai toh tu hamare paas farishton ko kyun nahi lata jo teri sachai hum se bayan karein. Firaun ne bhi yehi kaha tha ke ayat (Falau la ulqiya 'alaihi aswiratun min zahabin au ja'a ma'ahu al-mala'ikatu muqtarinin) 43. Az-Zukhruf: 53. Us par sone ke kangan kyun nahi dale gaye? Us ke sath mil kar farishte kyun nahi aaye? Rabb ki mulaqat ke munkiron ne aawaz uthai ke hum par farishte kyun nazil nahi kiye jate? Ya yehi hota ke hum khud apne Parwardigar ko dekh lete. Darasal yeh ghamand mein aa gaye aur bahut hi sarkash ho gaye. Farishton ko dekh lene ka din jab aa jayega, us din in gunahgaron ko koi khushi na hogi. Yahan bhi farman hai ke hum farishton ko haq ke sath hi utarte hain, yani risalat ya azab ke sath, us waqt phir kafiron ko mohlat nahi milegi. Is zikr yani Quran ko hum ne hi utara hai aur is ki hifazat ke zimmedar bhi hum hi hain, hamesha taghayyur-o-tabaddul se bacha rahega. Baaz kehte hain ke 'ha' ki zameer ka marja' Nabi ﷺ hain yani Quran Allah hi ka nazil kiya hua hai aur Nabi ﷺ ka hafiz wahi hai jaise farman hai ayat (Wallahu ya'simuka minan-nas, innal-laha la yahdil-qaumal-kafirin) 5. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ ko taskeen deta hai ke jis tarah log aap ko jhutla rahe hain usi tarah aap se pehle ke nabiyon ko bhi woh jhutla chuke hain. Har ummat ke Rasool ﷺ ki takzeeb hui hai aur use mazaq mein uraya gaya hai. Ziddi aur mutakabir giroh ke dilon mein ba-sabab un ke had se barhe hue gunahon ke takzeeb-e-Rasool samo di jati hai yahan mujrimon se murad mushrikeen hain. Woh haq ko qubool karte hi nahi, na karein. Aglon ki aadat un ke samne hai jis tarah woh halak aur barbad hue aur un ke anbiya najat pa gaye aur iman dar aafiyat hasil kar gaye. Wohi nateeja yeh bhi yaad rakhein. Duniya aakhirat ki bhalai Nabi ﷺ ki mutaba'at mein aur dono jahan ki ruswai Nabi ki mukhalifat mein hai.

Un ki sarsakshi, zidd, hatt, khud-bini aur batil-parasti ki toh yeh kaifiyat hai ke bil-farz agar un ke liye aasman ka darwaza khol diya jaye aur unhein wahan chadha diya jaye toh bhi yeh haq ko haq keh kar na manenge balki us waqt bhi hank lagayenge ke hamari nazar-bandi kardi gayi hai, aankhein behka di gayi hain, jadoo kar diya gaya hai, nigah cheen li gayi hai, dhoka ho raha hai, bewquf banaya ja raha hai.

Sitare aur shaitan is buland asman ka jo thahray rehne wale aur chalne phirne wale sitaron se zeenat-dar hai, paida karne wala Allah hi hai. Jo bhi ise ghaur-o-fikr se dekhe woh ajaibat-e-qudrat aur nishanat-e-ibrat apne liye bahut se pa sakta hai. Burooj se murad yahan par sitare hain. Jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (Tabarakal-lazina ja'ala fis-sama'i buroojan wa ja'ala fiha sirajan wa qamaram munira) (Al-Furqan: 61). Baz ka qaul hai ke murad suraj chand ki manzilein hain, Atiyyah kahte hain woh jagheinf jahan chauki pehre hain. Aur jahan se sarkaash shaitanoun par maar parti hai ke woh buland-o-bala farishton ki guftugu na sun saken. Jo aage parhta hai, shola uske jalane ko lapakta hai. Kabhi to niche wale ke kaan mein baat dalne se pehle hi uska kaam khatam hojata hai, kabhi iske barkhilaf bhi hota hai jaise ke Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein sarahatan marwi hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala asman mein kisi amr ki babat faisla karta hai to farishte aajizi ke sath apne par jhuka lete hain jaise zanjeer patthar par. Phir jab unke dil mutma'in hojate hain to daryaft karte hain ke tumhare Rabb ka kya irshad hua? Woh kahte hain jo bhi farmaya haq hai aur wohi buland-o-bala aur bahut bara hai. Farishton ki baaton ko chori chori sunne ke liye jinnaat upar ki taraf charhte hain aur is tarah ek par ek hota hai. Rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Safwan ne apne hath ke ishare se is tarah bataya ke dahne hath ki ungliyan kushada kar ke ek ko ek par rakh li. Shola us sunne wale ka kaam kabhi to usse pehle hi khatam kar deta hai ke woh apne sathi ke kaan mein keh de. Usi waqt woh jal jata hai aur kabhi aisa bhi hota hai ke yeh usse aur woh apne se niche wale ko aur isi tarah musalsal pohcha de aur woh baat zameen tak ajaye aur jadugar ya kahin ke kaan isse ashna hojayein phir to woh iske sath sau jhoot mila kar logon mein phaila deta hai. Jab iski woh ek baat jo asman se use ittefaqan pohch gayi thi sahih nikalti hai to logon mein uski danmandi ke charche hone lagte hain ke dekho falan ne falan din yeh kaha tha bilkul sach nikla. Phir Allah Ta'ala zameen ka zikr farmata hai ke usi ne ise paida kiya, phailaya, is mein pahaar banaye, jangal aur maidan qayam kiye, khet aur baghaat aur tamam cheezein andaze, munasibat aur mozooniyat ke sath har ek mausam, har ek zameen, har ek mulk ke lihaz se bilkul theek paida keen jo bazar ki zeenat aur logon ke liye khushgwar hain. Zameen mein qism qism ki maeeshat us ne paida kar deen aur unhe bhi paida kiya jinke rozi-rasan tum nahi ho. Yani chaupaye aur janwar, laundi ghulam waghera. Pas qism qism ki cheezein, qism qism ke asbab, qism qism ki rahat, har tarah ke aram, us ne tumhare liye mohayya kar diye. Kamai ke tareeqe tumhe sikhaye janwaro ko tumhare zer-dast kar diya taake khao bhi, sawariyan bhi karo, laundi ghulam diye ke rahat-o-aram hasil karo.

In ki roziyan bhi kuch tumhare zimma nahin balki un ka razaq bhi Allah hai. Nafa tum uthao rozi woh pohchaye fasubhanahu a'azam shanuh.

Jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (Tabarakal-lazina ja'ala fis-sama'i buroojan wa ja'ala fiha sirajan wa qamaram munira) (Al-Furqan: 61). Baz ka qaul hai ke murad suraj chand ki manzilein hain, Atiyyah kahte hain woh jagheinf jahan chauki pehre hain. Aur jahan se sarkaash shaitanoun par maar parti hai ke woh buland-o-bala farishton ki guftugu na sun saken. Jo aage parhta hai, shola uske jalane ko lapakta hai. Kabhi to niche wale ke kaan mein baat dalne se pehle hi uska kaam khatam hojata hai, kabhi iske barkhilaf bhi hota hai jaise ke Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein sarahatan marwi hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala asman mein kisi amr ki babat faisla karta hai to farishte aajizi ke sath apne par jhuka lete hain jaise zanjeer patthar par. Phir jab unke dil mutma'in hojate hain to daryaft karte hain ke tumhare Rabb ka kya irshad hua? Woh kahte hain jo bhi farmaya haq hai aur wohi buland-o-bala aur bahut bara hai. Farishton ki baaton ko chori chori sunne ke liye jinnaat upar ki taraf charhte hain aur is tarah ek par ek hota hai. Rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Safwan ne apne hath ke ishare se is tarah bataya ke dahne hath ki ungliyan kushada kar ke ek ko ek par rakh li. Shola us sunne wale ka kaam kabhi to usse pehle hi khatam kar deta hai ke woh apne sathi ke kaan mein keh de. Usi waqt woh jal jata hai aur kabhi aisa bhi hota hai ke yeh usse aur woh apne se niche wale ko aur isi tarah musalsal pohcha de aur woh baat zameen tak ajaye aur jadugar ya kahin ke kaan isse ashna hojayein phir to woh iske sath sau jhoot mila kar logon mein phaila deta hai. Jab iski woh ek baat jo asman se use ittefaqan pohch gayi thi sahih nikalti hai to logon mein uski danmandi ke charche hone lagte hain ke dekho falan ne falan din yeh kaha tha bilkul sach nikla. Phir Allah Ta'ala zameen ka zikr farmata hai ke usi ne ise paida kiya, phailaya, is mein pahaar banaye, jangal aur maidan qayam kiye, khet aur baghaat aur tamam cheezein andaze, munasibat aur mozooniyat ke sath har ek mausam, har ek zameen, har ek mulk ke lihaz se bilkul theek paida keen jo bazar ki zeenat aur logon ke liye khushgwar hain. Zameen mein qism qism ki maeeshat us ne paida kar deen aur unhe bhi paida kiya jinke rozi-rasan tum nahi ho. Yani chaupaye aur janwar, laundi ghulam waghera. Pas qism qism ki cheezein, qism qism ke asbab, qism qism ki rahat, har tarah ke aram, us ne tumhare liye mohayya kar diye. Kamai ke tareeqe tumhe sikhaye janwaro ko tumhare zer-dast kar diya taake khao bhi, sawariyan bhi karo, laundi ghulam diye ke rahat-o-aram hasil karo.

In ki roziyan bhi kuch tumhare zimma nahin balki un ka razaq bhi Allah hai. Nafa tum uthao rozi woh pohchaye fasubhanahu a'azam shanuh.

Allah Ta'ala ke khazane tamaam cheezon ka tanha maalik Allah Ta'ala hai. Har kaam us par aasan hai. Har qisam ki cheezon ke khazane us ke paas maujud hain. Jitna, jab aur jahan chahta hai, nazil farmata hai. Apni hikmaton ka aalim wahi hai. Bandon ki maslahatyon se bhi waqif hai. Yeh mahz us ki meharbani hai warna kaun hai jo us par jabr karsake. 

Hadrat Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain har saal barish barabar hi barsti hai. Haan taqseem Allah ke haath hai, phir aap ne yehi aayat tilawat farmai. Hakam bin Uyinah se bhi yehi qaul marwi hai, kehte hain ke barish ke sath is qadr farishte utarte hain, jin ki ginti kul insano aur jinnaat se ziyada hoti hai, ek ek qatray ka khayal rakhte hain ke woh kahan barsa aur us se kya ugaa. 

Bazzar mein hai ke Allah ke paas ke khazane kya hain? Sirf kalaam hai jab kaha hoja hogaya. Is ka ek raawi qawi nahi. 

Hwa chala kar hum badalon ko pani se boojhal karde hain, is mein pani barasne lagta hai. Yehi hawayein chal kar darakhton ko baar-dar kar deti hain ke pattey aur konpalen phootne lagti hain. Is wasf ko bhi khayal mein rakhiye ke yahan jama ka seegah laye hain aur rih-e-aqeemah mein wasf-e-wahdat ke sath kiya hai taake kasrat se natija bar-amad ho. 

Baardari kam az kam do cheezon ke baghair namumkin hai. Hwa chalti hai woh aasman se pani uthati hai aur badalon ko pur kar deti hai. Ek hwa hoti hai jo zameen mein paidawar ki quwwat paida karti hai, ek hwa hoti hai jo badalon ko idhar udhar se uthati hai, ek hwa hoti hai jo unhein jama kar ke teh ba teh kar deti hai, ek hwa hoti hai jo unhein pani se boojhal kar deti hai, ek hwa hoti hai jo darakhton ko phal daar hone ke qabil kar deti hai. 

Ibn Jareer mein bi-sanad-e-daeef ek hadith marwi hai ke junoobi hwa jannati hai is mein logon ke manafae hain aur ishi ka zikr Kitabullah mein hai. Musnad Humaidi ki hadith mein hai ke hawayon ke saat saal baad Allah Ta'ala ne jannat mein ek hwa paida ki hai jo ek darwaze se ruki hui hai. Isi band darwaze se tumhein hwa pahunchti rehti hai, agar woh khul jaye toh zameen-o-aasman ki tamaam cheezein hwa se ulat-pult hojayen. Allah ke haan is ka naam Azeeb hai, tum ise junoobi hwa kehte ho, phir farmata hai ke is ke baad hum tum par meetha pani barasate hain ke tum piyo aur kaam mein laao. 

Agar hum chahein toh ise karwa aur khaari kardein. Jaise Surah Al-Waqiah mein farman hai ke jis methe pani ko tum piya karte ho ise badal se barasane wale bhi kya tum hi ho? Ya hum hain? Agar hum chahein toh ise karwa kardein tajjub hai ke tum hamari shukr guzari nahi karte? Aur aayat mein hai isi Allah ne tumhare liye aasman se pani utara hai. Al-Kh. Tum us ke khazin yaani mani aur haafiz nahi ho. Hum hi barasate hain hum hi jahan chahte hain, pahunchate hain, jahan chahte hain, mehfooz kar dete hain. 

Agar hum chahein zameen mein dhansa dein. Yeh sirf hamari rahmat hai ke ise barasaya, bachaya, meetha kiya, suthra kiya taake tum piyo, apne janwaron ko pilaao. Apni khetiyan aur baghaat basaao.

Apni zarooratein poori karo. Hum makhlooq ki ibtida aur phir is ke a'adah par qadir hain. Sab ko adam se wajood mein laye. Sab ko phir ma'doom hum karein ge. Phir Roz-e-Qayamat sab ko utha bithayein ge. Zameen ke aur zameen walon ke waris hum hi hain. Sab ke sab hamari taraf lautaye jayein ge. Hamare ilm ki koi inteha nahi. Awwal aakhir sab hamare ilm mein hai. Pas agay walon se murad to us zamanay se pehle ke log hain Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) tak ke. Aur pichlon se murad us zamanay ke aur ayenda zamanay ke log hain. 

Marwan bin Hakam se marwi hai ke ba'az log wajah aurton ke pichli safon mein raha karte thay pas yeh ayat utri. Is baray mein ek bohat hi ghareeb hadith bhi وارد hui hai Ibn Jareer mein Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke ek bohat hi khush shakal aurat namaz mein aya karti thi to ba'az musalman is khayal se ke us par nigah na paray, agay barh jate thay aur ba'az un ke khilaf aur peechhe hat atay thay aur sajde ki halat mein apne haathon tale se dekhte thay pas yeh ayat utri lekin is riwayat mein sakht nakarat hai. 

Abdul Razzaq mein Abu Al-Jawaz ka qaul is ayat ke baray mein marwi hai ke namaz ki safon mein agay barhney waley aur peechhe hatney waley. Yeh sirf un ka qaul hai Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka is mein zikr nahi. Imam Tirmizi (Rahimahullah Ta'ala) farmate hain yehi mushabih hai Wallahu A'lam. 

Muhammad bin Ka'ab ke samne Awn bin Abdullah jab yeh kehte hain to aap farmate hain yeh matlab nahi balkay aglon se murad woh hain jo mar chuke aur pichlon se murad ab paida shuda aur paida honay waley hain. Tera Rab sab ko jama karega woh hikmat aur ilm wala hai. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Awn (R.H) ne farmaya Allah aap ko taufeeq aur jazai khair de.

Isi band darwaze se tumhein hwa pahunchti rehti hai, agar woh khul jaye toh zameen-o-aasman ki tamaam cheezein hwa se ulat-pult hojayen. Allah ke haan is ka naam Azeeb hai, tum ise junoobi hwa kehte ho, phir farmata hai ke is ke baad hum tum par meetha pani barasate hain ke tum piyo aur kaam mein laao. 

Agar hum chahein toh ise karwa aur khaari kardein. Jaise Surah Al-Waqiah mein farman hai ke jis methe pani ko tum piya karte ho ise badal se barasane wale bhi kya tum hi ho? Ya hum hain? Agar hum chahein toh ise karwa kardein tajjub hai ke tum hamari shukr guzari nahi karte? Aur aayat mein hai isi Allah ne tumhare liye aasman se pani utara hai. Al-Kh. Tum us ke khazin yaani mani aur haafiz nahi ho. Hum hi barasate hain hum hi jahan chahte hain, pahunchate hain, jahan chahte hain, mehfooz kar dete hain. 

Agar hum chahein zameen mein dhansa dein. Yeh sirf hamari rahmat hai ke ise barasaya, bachaya, meetha kiya, suthra kiya taake tum piyo, apne janwaron ko pilaao. Apni khetiyan aur baghaat basaao.

Apni zarooratein poori karo. Hum makhlooq ki ibtida aur phir is ke a'adah par qadir hain. Sab ko adam se wajood mein laye. Sab ko phir ma'doom hum karein ge. Phir Roz-e-Qayamat sab ko utha bithayein ge. Zameen ke aur zameen walon ke waris hum hi hain. Sab ke sab hamari taraf lautaye jayein ge. Hamare ilm ki koi inteha nahi. Awwal aakhir sab hamare ilm mein hai. Pas agay walon se murad to us zamanay se pehle ke log hain Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) tak ke. Aur pichlon se murad us zamanay ke aur ayenda zamanay ke log hain. 

Marwan bin Hakam se marwi hai ke ba'az log wajah aurton ke pichli safon mein raha karte thay pas yeh ayat utri. Is baray mein ek bohat hi ghareeb hadith bhi وارد hui hai Ibn Jareer mein Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke ek bohat hi khush shakal aurat namaz mein aya karti thi to ba'az musalman is khayal se ke us par nigah na paray, agay barh jate thay aur ba'az un ke khilaf aur peechhe hat atay thay aur sajde ki halat mein apne haathon tale se dekhte thay pas yeh ayat utri lekin is riwayat mein sakht nakarat hai. 

Abdul Razzaq mein Abu Al-Jawaz ka qaul is ayat ke baray mein marwi hai ke namaz ki safon mein agay barhney waley aur peechhe hatney waley. Yeh sirf un ka qaul hai Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka is mein zikr nahi. Imam Tirmizi (Rahimahullah Ta'ala) farmate hain yehi mushabih hai Wallahu A'lam. 

Muhammad bin Ka'ab ke samne Awn bin Abdullah jab yeh kehte hain to aap farmate hain yeh matlab nahi balkay aglon se murad woh hain jo mar chuke aur pichlon se murad ab paida shuda aur paida honay waley hain. Tera Rab sab ko jama karega woh hikmat aur ilm wala hai. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Awn (R.H) ne farmaya Allah aap ko taufeeq aur jazai khair de.

Allah Ta'ala ke khazane tamaam cheezon ka tanha maalik Allah Ta'ala hai. Har kaam us par aasan hai. Har qisam ki cheezon ke khazane us ke paas maujud hain. Jitna, jab aur jahan chahta hai, nazil farmata hai. Apni hikmaton ka aalim wahi hai. Bandon ki maslahatyon se bhi waqif hai. Yeh mahz us ki meharbani hai warna kaun hai jo us par jabr karsake. 

Hadrat Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain har saal barish barabar hi barsti hai. Haan taqseem Allah ke haath hai, phir aap ne yehi aayat tilawat farmai. Hakam bin Uyinah se bhi yehi qaul marwi hai, kehte hain ke barish ke sath is qadr farishte utarte hain, jin ki ginti kul insano aur jinnaat se ziyada hoti hai, ek ek qatray ka khayal rakhte hain ke woh kahan barsa aur us se kya ugaa. 

Bazzar mein hai ke Allah ke paas ke khazane kya hain? Sirf kalaam hai jab kaha hoja hogaya. Is ka ek raawi qawi nahi. 

Hwa chala kar hum badalon ko pani se boojhal karde hain, is mein pani barasne lagta hai. Yehi hawayein chal kar darakhton ko baar-dar kar deti hain ke pattey aur konpalen phootne lagti hain. Is wasf ko bhi khayal mein rakhiye ke yahan jama ka seegah laye hain aur rih-e-aqeemah mein wasf-e-wahdat ke sath kiya hai taake kasrat se natija bar-amad ho. 

Baardari kam az kam do cheezon ke baghair namumkin hai. Hwa chalti hai woh aasman se pani uthati hai aur badalon ko pur kar deti hai. Ek hwa hoti hai jo zameen mein paidawar ki quwwat paida karti hai, ek hwa hoti hai jo badalon ko idhar udhar se uthati hai, ek hwa hoti hai jo unhein jama kar ke teh ba teh kar deti hai, ek hwa hoti hai jo unhein pani se boojhal kar deti hai, ek hwa hoti hai jo darakhton ko phal daar hone ke qabil kar deti hai.

Qiyamat tak tujh par abadi aur dawami la'nat barsa karegi. Kehte hain ke usi waqt uski soorat badal gayi aur us ne nauha khwani shuru ki, duniya mein tamam nauhe usi ibtida se hain. Mardood-o-matrood ho kar phir aatish-e-hasad se jalta hua aarzoo karta hai ke qiyamat tak ki use dheel di jaye usi ko Yaum-ul-Ba'as kaha gaya hai. Pas uski yeh darkhwast manzoor ki gayi aur mohlat mil gayi.

Iblis ke siyah karnamay: Iblis ki sarkashi bayan ho rahi hai ke us ne Allah ke gumrah karne ki qasam kha kar kaha. Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke us ne kaha ke chunke tune mujhe gumrah kiya main bhi aulad-e-adam ke liye zameen mein teri nafarmaniyon ko khoob zeenat-dar kar ke dikhaunga. Aur unhein raghbat dila dila kar nafarmaniyon mein mubtala karunga, jahan tak ho sakega koshish karunga ke sab ko hi behka dun. Lekin haan tere khalis bande mere haath nahi aa sakte. Ek aur ayat mein bhi hai ke go tune ise mujh par bartari di hai lekin ab main bhi is ki aulad ke peeche par jaunga, chahe kuch thore se chhoot jayen baaki sab ko hi le doobunga. Is par jawab mila ke tum sab ka lotna to meri hi taraf hai. Aamal ka badla main zaroor dunga naik ko naik bad ko bad jaise farman hai ke tera Rab taak mein hai. Gharz lotna aur lotne ka rasta Allah hi ki taraf hai. Ala ki ek qirat 'Ala' bhi hai. Jaise ayat (Wa innahu fi ummil-kitabi ladayna la-aliyun hakim) (Az-Zukhruf: 4) mein hai yaani buland lekin pehli qirat mashhoor hai. Jin bandon ko main ne hidayat par laga diya hai un par tera koi zor nahi haan tera zor tere tabadaron par hai. Yeh istisna munqati hai. Ibn Jarir mein hai ke bastiyon se bahar nabiyon ki masjidein hoti thi. Jab woh apne Rab se koi khas baat maloom karna chahte to wahan ja kar jo namaz muqaddar mein hoti ada kar ke sawal karte. Ek din ek nabi ke aur us ke qibla ke darmiyan shaitan baith gaya. Us nabi ne teen baar kaha ayat (A'uzu billahi minash-shaitanir-rajim). Shaitaan ne kaha aye Allah ke nabi akhir aap mere dao se kaise bach jate hain? Nabi ne kaha tu bata ke tu bani adam par kis dao se ghalib aa jata hai? Akhir muahida hua ke har ek sahih cheez doosre ko bata de to nabiyullah ne kaha sun Allah ka farman hai ke mere khas bandon par tera koi asar nahi. Sirf un par jo khud gumrah hon aur teri mat-haiti karein. Is Allah ke dushman ne kaha yeh aap ne kya farmaya ise to main aap ki paidaish se bhi pehle se jaanta hun, nabi ne kaha aur sun Allah ka farman hai ke jab shaitani harkat ho to Allah se panah talab kar, woh sunne janne wala hai. Wallah teri aahat pate hi main Allah se panah chaah leta hun. Us ne kaha sach hai isi se aap mere phandey mein nahi phanste. Nabiyullah (Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya ab to bata ke tu ibn-e-adam par kaise ghalib aa jata hai? Us ne kaha ke main ise ghusse aur khwahish ke waqt daboch leta hun. Phir farmata hai ke jo koi bhi Iblis ki pairovi kare, woh jahannami hai. Yahi farman Quran se kufr karne walon ki nisbat hai. Phir irshad hua ke jahannam ke kayi ek darwaze hain har darwaze se jaane wala Iblisi giroh muqarrar hai. Apne apne aamal ke mutabiq un ke liye darwaze taqseem shuda hain. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne apne ek khutbe mein farmaya jahannam ke darwaze is tarah hain yaani ek par ek. Aur woh saat hain ek ke baad ek kar ke saton darwaze par ho jayenge. Ikrimah (R.A) farmate hain saat tabaqey hain.

Ibn Jarir saat darwazon ke yeh naam batlate hain: Jahannam, Nati, Hutamah, Sa'ir, Saqar, Jaheem, Hawiyah. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se bhi isi tarah marwi hai. Qatadah (R.H) kehte hain yeh ba'itbaar-e-a'maal un ki manzilein hain. Zahhak kehte hain misal ke taur par aik darwaza Yahud ka, aik Nasara ka, aik Sabiyon ka, aik Majusiyon ka, aik mushrikeen kaafirion ka, aik munafiqon ka, aik Ahl-e-Tauhid ka, lekin tauhid walon ko chhutkaare ki umeed hai baqi sab na-umeed ho gaye hain. Tirmizi mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain ki ba'az dozakhiyon takhon tak aag hogi, ba'az ki kamar tak, ba'az ki gardanon tak, gharz gunahon ki miqdaar ke hisaab se.

Iblis ke siyah karnamay: Iblis ki sarkashi bayan ho rahi hai ke us ne Allah ke gumrah karne ki qasam kha kar kaha. Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke us ne kaha ke chunke tune mujhe gumrah kiya main bhi aulad-e-adam ke liye zameen mein teri nafarmaniyon ko khoob zeenat-dar kar ke dikhaunga. Gharz lotna aur lotne ka rasta Allah hi ki taraf hai. Ala ki ek qirat 'Ala' bhi hai. Akhir muahida hua ke har ek sahih cheez doosre ko bata de to nabiyullah ne kaha sun Allah ka farman hai ke mere khas bandon par tera koi asar nahi. Sirf un par jo khud gumrah hon aur teri mat-haiti karein. Is Allah ke dushman ne kaha yeh aap ne kya farmaya ise to main aap ki paidaish se bhi pehle se jaanta hun, nabi ne kaha aur sun Allah ka farman hai ke jab shaitani harkat ho to Allah se panah talab kar, woh sunne janne wala hai. Wallah teri aahat pate hi main Allah se panah chaah leta hun. Us ne kaha sach hai isi se aap mere phandey mein nahi phanste. Nabiyullah (Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya ab to bata ke tu ibn-e-adam par kaise ghalib aa jata hai? Us ne kaha ke main ise ghusse aur khwahish ke waqt daboch leta hun. Jannat mein koi bughz-o-kina na rahe ga. Dozakhiyon ka zikr kar ke ab jannatiyon ka zikr ho raha hai ke woh baghaat, nehron aur chashmon mein honge. Unko bisharat sunai jayegi ke ab tum har aafat se bach gaye, har dar aur ghabrahat se mutmain ho gaye. Na nematon ke zawal ka dar, na yahan se nikale jaane ka khatra, na fana na kami. Ahl-e-Jannat ke dilon mein go duniyavi ranjishen baqi reh gayi hon magar jannat mein jaate hi ek doosre se mil kar tamam gilay shikway khatam ho jayenge. 

Hazrat Abu Umamah farmaate hain ke jannat mein dakhil hone se pehle hi seenay be-kina ho jayenge. Chunache marfoo' hadith mein bhi hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmaate hain ke momin jahannam se nijat pa kar jannat dozakh ke darmiyan ke pul par rok liye jayenge, jo nachaqiyan aur zulm aapas mein thay, unka adla badla ho jayega aur pak dil, saaf seena ho kar jannat mein jayenge. 

Ashtar ne Hazrat Ali R.A ke paas aane ki ijazat mangi, us waqt aap ke paas Hazrat Talha ke sahibzaaday baithe thay to aap ne kuch der ke baad ise andar bulaya. Us ne kaha ke shayad in ki wajah se mujhe aap ne der se ijazat di? Aap ne farmaya: Sach hai. Kaha: Phir to agar aap ke paas Hazrat Usman R.A in logon mein se honge, jin ki shaan mein yeh hai ke unke dilon mein jo kuch khafgi thi hum ne door kar di, bhai bhai ho kar aamne saamne takht-e-shahi par jalwa farma hain. 

Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Imran bin Talha Ashab-e-Jamal se farigh ho kar Hazrat Ali R.A ke paas aaye, aap ne unhein marhabah kaha aur farmaya ke main umeed rakhta hoon ke main aur tumhare walid in mein se hain jin ke dilon ke ghussay Allah door kar ke bhai bhai bana kar jannat ke takhton par aamne saamne bithayega. 

Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh sun kar farsh ke konay par baithe hue do shakhson ne kaha: Allah ka ahad is se bahut barha hua hai ke jinhein aap qatal karein un ke bhai ban jayein? Aap ne ghusse se farmaya: Agar is ayat se murad mere aur Talha jaise log nahi to aur kaun honge? 

Aur riwayat mein hai ke qabila Hamdan ke ek shakhs ne yeh kaha tha aur Hazrat Ali R.A ne is dhamki aur buland aawaz se yeh jawab diya tha ke mahal hil gaya. Aur riwayat mein hai ke kehne wale ka naam Haris Awar tha aur is ki is baat par aap ne ghussa ho kar jo cheez aap ke haath mein thi woh is ke sar par maar kar yeh farmaya tha. 

Ibn Jarmoz jo Hazrat Zubair R.A ka qatil tha jab darbar-e-Ali R.A mein aaya to aap ne bari der baad ise dakhle ki ijazat di. Us ne aa kar Hazrat Zubair R.A aur un ke sathiyon ko bulwai keh kar burai se yaad kiya to aap ne farmaya: Tere munh mein mitti! Main aur Talha aur Zubair R.A to Insha'Allah in logon mein hain jin ki babat Allah ka yeh farman hai. 

Hazrat Ali R.A qasam kha kar farmaate hain ke hum Badriyon ki babat yeh ayat nazil hui hai. 

Kaseer kehte hain ke main Abu Jafar Muhammad bin Ali ke paas gaya aur kaha ke mere dost aap ke dost hain aur mujh se musalahat rakhne wale aap se musalahat rakhne wale hain, mere dushman aap ke dushman hain aur mujh se larai rakhne wale aap se larai rakhne wale hain.

Phir Aap ne usi ayat ke aakhri hisse ki tilawat farmai. Aur farmaya ke yeh un das shakhson ke bare mein hai Abu Bakr, Umar, Usman, Ali, Talha, Zubair, Abdul Rahman bin Auf, Saad bin Abi Waqas, Saeed bin Zaid aur Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ajmaeen. Yeh aamne samne honge taake kisi ki taraf kisi ki peeth na rahe. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Sahaba Rizwanullahi Alaihim Ajmaeen ke aik majma mein aa kar ise tilawat farma kar farmaya yeh aik doosre ko dekh rahe honge. Wahan unhe koi mashaqqat, takleef aur eza na hogi. Bukhari o Muslim mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain mujhe Allah ka hukm huwa hai ke main Hazrat Khadija (R.A) ko Jannat ke sone ke mahal ki khushkhabri suna doon jis mein na shor o ghul hai na takleef o museebat. Yeh jannati jannat se kabhi nikale na jayenge hadith mein hai un se farmaya jayega ke aey jantiyo tum hamesha tandrust rahoge kabhi beemar na paroge aur hamesha zinda rahoge kabhi na maroge aur hamesha jawan rahoge kabhi boorhe na banoge aur hamesha yehi rahoge kabhi nikale na jaoge. Aur ayat mein hai woh tabdeeli-e-makan ki khwahish hi na karenge na un ki jagah un se chhene gi. Aey Nabi (ﷺ) aap mere bandon se keh dijiye ke main Arham-ur-Rahimeen hoon. Aur mere azab bhi nihayat sakht hain. Isi jaisi ayat aur bhi guzar chuki hai. Is se murad yeh hai ke momin ko umeed ke sath dhar bhi rakhna chahiye. Huzoor (ﷺ) apne Sahaba Rizwanullahi Alaihim Ajmaeen ke paas aate hain aur unhe hansta huwa dekh kar farmate hain jannat dozakh ki yaad karo, us waqt yeh aayatein utrin. Yeh mursal hadith Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai. Aap Bani Shaiba ke darwaze se Sahaba ke paas aa kar kehte hain main toh tumhe hanste huwe dekh raha hoon yeh keh kar wapas mur gaye aur Hateem ke paas se hi ulte paon phire hamare paas aaye aur farmaya ke abhi main ja hi raha tha ke Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) aaye aur farmaya ke Janab-e-Bari irshad farmata hai ke tu mere bandon ko naumeed kar raha hai? Unhe mere Ghafoor-o-Raheem hone ki aur mere azabon ke almanaak hone ki khabar de de. Aur hadith mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya agar bande Allah Ta'ala ki muafiyan ko maloom kar lein toh haram se bachna chhor dein aur agar Allah ke azab ko maloom kar lein toh apne aap ko halak kar dalein.

Aur mere azab bhi nihayat sakht hain. Isi jaisi ayat aur bhi guzar chuki hai. Is se murad yeh hai ke momin ko umeed ke sath dhar bhi rakhna chahiye. Huzoor (ﷺ) apne Sahaba Rizwanullahi Alaihim Ajmaeen ke paas aate hain aur unhe hansta huwa dekh kar farmate hain jannat dozakh ki yaad karo, us waqt yeh aayatein utrin. Yeh mursal hadith Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai. Aap Bani Shaiba ke darwaze se Sahaba ke paas aa kar kehte hain main toh tumhe hanste huwe dekh raha hoon yeh keh kar wapas mur gaye aur Hateem ke paas se hi ulte paon phire hamare paas aaye aur farmaya ke abhi main ja hi raha tha ke Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) aaye aur farmaya ke Janab-e-Bari irshad farmata hai ke tu mere bandon ko naumeed kar raha hai? Unhe mere Ghafoor-o-Raheem hone ki aur mere azabon ke almanaak hone ki khabar de de. Aur hadith mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya agar bande Allah Ta'ala ki muafiyan ko maloom kar lein toh haram se bachna chhor dein aur agar Allah ke azab ko maloom kar lein toh apne aap ko halak kar dalein.

Jannat mein koi bughz-o-kina na rahe ga. Dozakhiyon ka zikr kar ke ab jannatiyon ka zikr ho raha hai ke woh baghaat, nehron aur chashmon mein honge. Unko bisharat sunai jayegi ke ab tum har aafat se bach gaye, har dar aur ghabrahat se mutmain ho gaye. Na nematon ke zawal ka dar, na yahan se nikale jaane ka khatra, na fana na kami. Ahl-e-Jannat ke dilon mein go duniyavi ranjishen baqi reh gayi hon magar jannat mein jaate hi ek doosre se mil kar tamam gilay shikway khatam ho jayenge. 

Hazrat Abu Umamah farmaate hain ke jannat mein dakhil hone se pehle hi seenay be-kina ho jayenge. Chunache marfoo' hadith mein bhi hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmaate hain ke momin jahannam se nijat pa kar jannat dozakh ke darmiyan ke pul par rok liye jayenge, jo nachaqiyan aur zulm aapas mein thay, unka adla badla ho jayega aur pak dil, saaf seena ho kar jannat mein jayenge. 

Ashtar ne Hazrat Ali R.A ke paas aane ki ijazat mangi, us waqt aap ke paas Hazrat Talha ke sahibzaaday baithe thay to aap ne kuch der ke baad ise andar bulaya. Us ne kaha ke shayad in ki wajah se mujhe aap ne der se ijazat di? Aap ne farmaya: Sach hai. Kaha: Phir to agar aap ke paas Hazrat Usman R.A in logon mein se honge, jin ki shaan mein yeh hai ke unke dilon mein jo kuch khafgi thi hum ne door kar di, bhai bhai ho kar aamne saamne takht-e-shahi par jalwa farma hain. 

Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Imran bin Talha Ashab-e-Jamal se farigh ho kar Hazrat Ali R.A ke paas aaye, aap ne unhein marhabah kaha aur farmaya ke main umeed rakhta hoon ke main aur tumhare walid in mein se hain jin ke dilon ke ghussay Allah door kar ke bhai bhai bana kar jannat ke takhton par aamne saamne bithayega. 

Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh sun kar farsh ke konay par baithe hue do shakhson ne kaha: Allah ka ahad is se bahut barha hua hai ke jinhein aap qatal karein un ke bhai ban jayein? Aap ne ghusse se farmaya: Agar is ayat se murad mere aur Talha jaise log nahi to aur kaun honge?

Main aur Talha aur Zubair R.A to Insha'Allah in logon mein hain jin ki babat Allah ka yeh farman hai. 

Hazrat Ali R.A qasam kha kar farmaate hain ke hum Badriyon ki babat yeh ayat nazil hui hai.

Lot A.S ko Hidayat:

Hazrat Lot A.S se farishte keh rahe hain ke raat ka kuch hissa guzarte hi aap apne walon ko lekar yahan se chale jayein. Khud aap in sab ke peeche rahein taake unki achhi tarah nigrani kar sakein. Yahi sunnat Rasulullah ﷺ ki thi ke aap lashkar ke aakhir mein chala karte the taake kamzor aur gire pade logon ka khayal rahe. 

Phir farma diya ke jab kaum par azab aaye aur unka shor-o-ghal sunai de toh hargiz unki taraf nazrein na uthana, unhe usi azab-o-saza mein chhod kar tumhe jaane ka hukum hai, chale jao goya unke sath koi tha jo unhe rasta dikhata jaye. 

Humne pehle hi se Lot A.S se farma diya tha ke subah ke waqt yeh log mita diye jayenge. Jaise doosri aayat mein hai ke unke azab ka waqt subah hai jo bahut hi kareeb hai.

Qaum-e-Lut ki khur-mastiyan: Qaum-e-Lut ko jab maloom hua ke Hazrat Lut (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ke ghar naujawan khubsurat mehman aaye hain toh woh apne bad-irade se khushiyan manate hue charh dore. Hazrat Lut (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne unhe samjhana shuru kiya ke Allah se daro, mere mehmano mein mujhe ruswa na karo. Us waqt khud Hazrat Lut (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ko yeh maloom na tha ke yeh farishte hain. Jaise ke Surah Hud mein hai. Yahan go iska zikr baad mein hai aur farishton ka zahir ho jana pehle zikr hua hai lekin isse tarteeb maqsood nahi. Waw tarteeb ke liye hota bhi nahi aur khasosan aisi jagah jahan iske khilaf daleel maujood ho. Aap unse kehte hain ke meri aabru-rezi ke dar-pe ho jao. Lekin woh jawab dete hain ke jab aap ko yeh khayal tha toh unhe aap ne apna mehman kyun banaya? Hum toh aap ko isse mana kar chuke hain. Tab aap ne unhe mazeed samjhate hue farmaya ke tumhari aurtein jo meri ladkiyan hain, woh khwahish poori karne ki cheezein hain na ke yeh. Iska poora bayan nihayat wazahat ke sath hum pehle bayan kar chuke hain isliye dohrane ki zaroorat nahi.

Chunki yeh bad-log apni khur-masti mein the aur jo qaza aur azab unke saro par jhoom raha tha isse ghafil the isliye Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki qasam kha kar unki yeh halat bayan farma raha hai. Ismein An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki bohat takreem aur ta'zeem hai. Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne apni jitni makhlooq paida ki hai unmein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zyada buzurg koi nahi. Allah ne aap ki hayat ke siva kisi ki hayat ki qasam nahi khayi.

Sakrat se murad zalalat-o-gumraahi hai, isi mein woh khel rahe the aur taraddud mein the.

Aal-e-Hud ka ibratnaak anjam. Suraj nikalne ke waqt aasman se ek dil dehlane wali aur jigar pash pash karde wali chinghaar ki aawaz aayi. Aur sath hi unki bastiyan ooper ko uthin aur aasman ke kareeb pahunch gayin aur wahan se ulat di gayin, ooper ka hissa niche aur niche ka hissa ooper hogaya, sath hi un par aasman se patthar barse aise jaise paki mitti ke kankar aalood patthar hon. Surah Hud mein is ka mufassal bayan hochuka hai. Jo bhi baseerat-o-basarat se kaam le, dekhe, sune, soche, samjhe, us ke liye in bastiyon ki barbadi mein bari bari nishaniyan mojood hain. Aise paakbaz log zara zara si cheezon se bhi ibrat-o-naseehat hasil karte hain, pand pakarte hain aur gaur se in waqeat ko dekhte hain aur ulm tak pahunch jaate hain. Tamallul aur gaur-o-khauz kar ke apni halat sanwar lete hain. Tirmizi waghera mein hadith hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain: Momin ki aqlmandi aur door-bini ka lihaz rakho, woh Allah ke noor ke sath dekhta hai. Phir aap ne yehi aayaat tilawat farmai. Aur hadith mein hai ke woh Allah ke noor aur Allah ki taufeeq se dekhta hai. Aur hadith mein hai ke Allah ke bande logon ko in nishanaat se pehchan lete hain. Yeh basti shara-e-aam par mojood hai jis par zahiri aur batni azaab aaya, ulat gayi, patthar khaye, azaab ka nishana bani. Ab ek gande aur badmaza khai ki jheel se bani hui hai, tum raat din wahan se aate jaate ho, tajjub hai ke phir bhi aqlmandi se kaam nahi lete. Garz saaf wazeh aur aamad-o-raft ke raste par yeh ulti ho basti mojood hai. Yeh bhi maani kiye hain ke Kitab-e-Mubeen mein hai lekin yeh maani kuch zyada band nahi baithte, Wallahu A'lam. Allah aur uske Rasool par iman lane walon ke liye yeh ek khuli daleel aur jari nishani hai ke kis tarah Allah apne walon ko nijat deta hai aur apne dushmanon ko gharat karta hai.

Ashab-e-Aiykah ka almi-nak anjam Ashab-e-Aiykah se murad Qaum-e-Shu'aib hai. Aiykah kehte hain drakhtoun ke jhund ko. Unka zulm alawa shirk o kufr ke gharat-gari aur naap tol ki kami bhi thi. Unki basti Lutiyon ke qareeb thi aur unka zamana bhi unse bohat qareeb tha. Un par bhi unki paiham shararaton ki wajah se Azab-e-Ilahi aya. Yeh dono bastian bar sar-e-shari-e-aam thin. Hazrat Shu'aib (Alaihis Salam) ne apni qaum ko darate hue farmaya tha ke Lut ki qaum tum se kuch door nahi.

Aal-e-Samood ki tabaahiyaan. Hijar walon se murad Samoodi hain jinhon ne apne Nabi Hazrat Salih (A.S) ko jhutlaya tha aur zahir hai ke ek Nabi ka jhutlane wala goya sab nabiyon ka inkar karne wala hai. Isi liye farmaya gaya ke unhon ne nabiyon ko jhutlaya. Unke paas aise mojze pahuche jin se Hazrat Salih (A.S) ki sachai un par khul gayi. Jaise ke ek sakht patthar ki chattan se oontni ka nikalna jo unke shahron mein charti chugti thi aur ek din woh pani piti thi ek din shahron ke janwar. Magar phir bhi yeh log gardan-kash hi rahe balki us oontni ko maar dala. Us waqt Hazrat Salih (A.S) ne farmaya bas ab teen din ke andar andar qahr-e-Ilahi nazil hoga. Yeh bilkul sacha wada hai aur atal azab hai. In logon ne Allah ki batlai hui rah par bhi apne andhepan ko tarjeeh di. Yeh log sirf apni quwat jatane aur riya-kari zahir karne ke vaste takabbur-o-tajabbur ke taur par pahadon mein makan tarashte the. Kisi khauf ke bais ya zarooratan yeh cheez na thi. Jab Rasool Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Tabook jate hue unke makanon se guzre toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne sar par kapra dal liya aur sawari ko tez chalaya aur apne sathiyon se farmaya ke jin par azab-e-Ilahi utra hai unki bastiyon se rote hue guzro. Agar rona na aaye toh rone jaisi shakal bana kar chalo ke kahin aisa na ho ke unhen azabon ka shikaar tum bhi ban jao. Aakhir un par theek chothe din ki subah azab-e-Ilahi basoorat-e-changhaar aaya. Us waqt unki kamaiyan kuch kaam na aayen. Jin kheton aur phoolon ki hifazat ke liye aur unhe barhane ke liye un logon ne oontni ka pani pina na pasand kar ke use qatl kar diya woh aaj besood sabit hue aur Amr-e-Rabb apna kaam kar gaya.

Nabi Akram ﷺ ko tasliyan. Allah ne tamam makhlooq adl ke sath banai hai, qayamat aane wali hai, buron ko bure badle nekion ko nek badle milne wale hain. Makhlooq baatil se paida nahi ki gai. Aisa guman kafiron ka hota hai aur kafiron ke liye weil dozakh hai. Aur aat mein hai kya tum samajhte ho ke hum ne tumhein bekaar paida kiya hai aur tum hamari taraf laut kar nahi aaoge? Bulandi wala hai Allah Malik-e-Haq jis ke siwa koi qabil-e-parastish nahi, Arsh-e-Kareem ka malik wahi hai. Phir apne Nabi ko hukam deta hai ke mushrikon se chashm-poshi kijiye, un ki eza aur jhutlana aur bura kehna bardasht kar lijiye. Jaise aur aayat mein hai: un se chashm-poshi kijiye aur salam keh dijiye, unhein abhi maloom ho jayega. Yeh hukam jihad ke hukam se pehle tha, yeh aayat Makkiya hai aur jihad baad az hijrat muqarrar aur shuru hua hai. Tera Rabb Khaliq hai aur Khaliq maar dalne ke baad bhi paidaish par qadir hai, use kisi cheez ki baar baar ki paidaish aajiz nahi kar sakti. Rezron ko jab bikhar jayenge woh jama kar ke jaan daal sakta hai. Jaise farman hai: Awal-allazi khalaq-as-samawati wal-arda bi-qadirin ala an yakhluqa mithlahum, bala wa huwal-khallaq-ul-aleem (36 (Ya-Sin: 81), asmaan-o-zameen ka khaliq kya un jaison ki paidaish ki qudrat nahi rakhta? Beshak woh paida karne wala, ilm wala hai. Woh jab kisi baat ka irada karta hai toh use ho jaane ko keh deta hai, bas woh ho jati hai. Paak zaat hai us Allah ki jis ke hath mein har cheez ki malqiyat hai aur usi ki taraf tum sab lautaye jaoge.)

Nabi Akram ﷺ ko tasliyan. Allah ne tamam makhlooq adl ke sath banai hai, qayamat aane wali hai, buron ko bure badle nekion ko nek badle milne wale hain. Makhlooq baatil se paida nahi ki gai. Aisa guman kafiron ka hota hai aur kafiron ke liye weil dozakh hai. Aur aat mein hai kya tum samajhte ho ke hum ne tumhein bekaar paida kiya hai aur tum hamari taraf laut kar nahi aaoge? Bulandi wala hai Allah Malik-e-Haq jis ke siwa koi qabil-e-parastish nahi, Arsh-e-Kareem ka malik wahi hai. Phir apne Nabi ko hukam deta hai ke mushrikon se chashm-poshi kijiye, un ki eza aur jhutlana aur bura kehna bardasht kar lijiye. Jaise aur aayat mein hai: un se chashm-poshi kijiye aur salam keh dijiye, unhein abhi maloom ho jayega. Yeh hukam jihad ke hukam se pehle tha, yeh aayat Makkiya hai aur jihad baad az hijrat muqarrar aur shuru hua hai. Tera Rabb Khaliq hai aur Khaliq maar dalne ke baad bhi paidaish par qadir hai, use kisi cheez ki baar baar ki paidaish aajiz nahi kar sakti. Rezron ko jab bikhar jayenge woh jama kar ke jaan daal sakta hai. Qur'an-e-Azeem Sab'a Masani aur aik la-zawal daulat. 

Aey Nabi ﷺ hum ne jab Qur'an-e-Azeem jaisi la-zawal daulat tujhe inayat farma rakhi hai toh tujhe na chahiye ke kafiron ke duniyavi maal-o-mataath aur thaath baath lalchayi hui nazaron se dekhe. Yeh toh sab fani hai aur sirf un ki aazmaish ke liye chand roza inhein ata hua hai. Sath hi tujhe un ke iman na laane par sadmay aur afsos ki bhi chandhaan zaroorat nahi. Haan tujhe chahiye ke narmi, khush khulqi, tawazu aur milansari ke sath momino se pesh aata rahe. Jaise irshad hai aayat (Laqad ja'akum rasulun min anfusikum 'azizun 'alayhi ma 'anittum harisun 'alaykum bil-mu'minina ra'ufur rahim) 9. (At-Taubah:128) 

Logo tumhare paas tum mein se hi aik Rasool aa gaye hain jin par tumhari takleef shaq guzarti hai jo tumhari behboodi ka dil se khwahan hai jo musalmano par parle darje ka shafiq-o-meharban hai. 

Sab'a Masani ki nisbat aik qaul toh yeh hai ke is se murad Qur'an-e-Kareem ki ibtida ki saat lambi surtein hain, Surah Baqarah, Al-Imran, Nisa, Ma'idah, An'am, A'raf aur Yunus. Is liye ke un surton mein faraiz ka, hudood ka, qisson ka aur ahkam ka khas tareeq par bayan hai is tarah misalein, khabrein aur ibratein bhi zyada hain. Baaz ne Surah A'raf tak ki chhe surtein ginwa kar saatween surat Anfal aur Bara'at ko batlaya hai, un ke nazdeek yeh dono surtein mil kar aik hi surat hain. Ibn Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke sirf Hazrat Musa A.S ko chhe mili theen lekin jab aap ne takhtiyan gira din toh do uth gain aur chaar reh gain. Aik qaul hai Qur'an-e-Azeem se murad bhi yahi hain. Zyada kehte hain main ne tujhe saat juz diye hain, hukam, mana, basharat, dar aur misalein, nematon ka shumar aur qur'ani khabrein. 

Dusra qaul yeh hai ke murad Sab'a Masani se Surah Fatihah hai jis ki saat aayatein hain. Yeh saat aayatein (Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim samait hain). Un ke sath Allah ne tumhe مخصوص kiya hai yeh kitab ka shuru hain aur har rakat mein dohrai jati hain, khwah farz namaz ho khwah nafal namaz ho. Imam Ibn Jareer R.H isi qaul ko pasand farmate hain aur is bare mein jo hadeethein marwi hain un se is par istadlal karte hain, hum ne woh tamam ahadeeth fazail Surah Fatihah ke bayan mein apni is tafsir ke awal mein likh di hain falhamdulillah. 

Imam Bukhari R.H ne is jagah do hadeethein وارد farmai hain. Aik mein hai Hazrat Abu Saeed bin Ma'alla R.A farmate hain main namaz parh raha tha jo An-Hazrat ﷺ aaye mujhe bulaya lekin main aap ke paas na aaya namaz khatam kar ke pohncha toh aap ne poocha ke usi waqt kyun na aaye? Main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah main namaz mein tha. Aap ne farmaya kya Allah Ta'ala ka yeh farman nahi aayat (Ya ayyuha al-lazina amanu istajibuli lillahi wa lir-rasuli iza da'akum lima yuhyikum wa'lamu ann Allah yahulu bainal-mar'i wa qalbihi wa annahu ilaihi tuhsharun) 8.

(Al-Anfal: 24) Yani iman walo Allah aur uske Rasool ki baat maan lo jab bhi woh tumhein pukarein. Sun ab main tujhe masjid mein se nikalne se pehle hi Quran-e-Kareem ki bahut badi soorat batlaunga. Thodi der mein jab Huzoor ﷺ tashreef le jaane lage toh maine aapka wada yaad dilaya aapne farmaya woh soorat ayat (Alhamdulillah Rabbil Alameen) ki hai yehi Sab'u Masani hai aur yehi bada Quran hai jo mujhe diya gaya hoon. Doosri mein aapka farman hai ke Ummul Quran yaani Soorat Fatiha Sab'u Masani aur Quran-e-Azeem hai. Pas saaf sabit hai ke Sab'u Masani aur Quran-e-Azeem se murad Soorat Fatiha lekin ye bhi khayal rahe ke iske siwa aur bhi yehi hai iske khilaf yeh hadeethein nahi. Jab ke un mein bhi yeh haqeeqat payi jaye jaise ke poore Quran-e-Kareem ka wasf bhi iske mukhalif nahi. Jaise farman-e-Ilahi hai ayat (Allahu nazzala ahsanal-hadithi kitaban mutashabihan mathani) pas is ayat mein saare Quran ko Masani kaha gaya hai. Aur mutashabih bhi. Pas woh ek tarah se Masani hai aur doosri wajah se mutashabih. Aur Quran-e-Azeem bhi yehi hai jaise ke is riwayat se sabit hai ke Huzoor ﷺ se sawal hua ke taqwa par jis masjid ki bina hai woh kaun hai? Toh aapne apni masjid ki taraf ishara kiya halanki yeh bhi sabit hai ke ayat Masjid-e-Quba ke bare mein utri hai. Pas qayda yehi hai ke kisi cheez ka zikr doosri cheez se inkar nahi hota. Jab ke woh bhi wahi sifat rakhti ho. Wallahu A'lam. Pas tujhe unki zahiri teep-taap se beniyaaz rehna chahiye isi farman ki bina par Imam Ibn-e-Uyaynah ؒ ne ek sahih hadees jis mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya hum mein se woh nahi jo Quran ke sath taghanni na kare ki tafseer yeh likhi hai ke Quran ko lekar iske maswa se dast-bardar aur be-parwah na hojaye woh musalman nahi. Go yeh tafseer bilkul sahih hai lekin is hadees se yeh maqsood nahi hadees ka sahih maqsad is hamari tafseer ke shuru mein hum ne bayan kardiya hai Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ke haan ek martaba mehmaan aaye aapke ghar mein kuch na tha aap ne ek yahudi se Rajab ke wade par aata udhar mangwaya lekin usne kaha baghair kisi cheez ko rahan rakhe main nahi doonga us waqt Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya Wallahu main ameen hoon aur zameen walon mein bhi agar yeh mujhe udhar deta ya mere hath farokht kardeta toh main isey zaroor ada karta pas ayat (Lā tamuddanna ‘aynayka ilā mā matta‘nā bihī azwājam minhum wa lā tahzan ‘alayhim wakhfid janāhaka lil-mu’minīn 15. (Al-Hijr: 88) nazil hui aur goya aapki dil-jooi ki gayi. Ibn Abbas ؓ farmate hain insan ka mamnoo hai ke kisi ke maal-o-mataq ko lalchayi hui nigahon se takey. Yeh jo farmaya ke unki jama'aton ko jo faida hum ne de rakha hai is se murad kuffaar ke maldar log hain.)

Anbiya ki takzib azab-e-ilahi ka sabab hai hukm hota hai ke اے پیغمبر ﷺ (Aiy Paighambar-e-Karam ﷺ) aap ailan kar dijiye ke main tamam logon ko azab-e-ilahi se saf saf dara dene wala hoon. Yaad rakho mere jhutlane wale bhi agle nabiyon ke jhutlane walon ki tarah azab-e-ilahi ke shikar honge. Al-Musta'in se murad kasme khane wale hain jo anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ki takzib aur un ki mukhalifat aur izaa-dehi par aapas mein qasma-qasmi kar lete the jaise ke Qaum-e-Salih ka bayan Quran-e-Hakim mein hai ke un logon ne Allah ki kasme kha kar ahad kiya ke raton rat Salih aur un ke gharane ko hum maut ke ghat utar denge isi tarah Quran mein hai ke woh kasme kha kha kar kehte the ke murde phir jine ke nahi Al-Kh. Aur jagah un ka is baat par kasme khane ka zikr hai ke Musalmanon ko kabhi koi rehmat nahi mil sakti. Al-Gharaz jis cheez ko na mante us par kasme khane ki unhe aadat thi is liye unhe kaha gaya hai. 

Bukhari o Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke meri aur un hidayat ki misal jise de kar Allah ne mujhe bheja hai us shakhs ki si hai jo apni qaum ke pas aa kar kahe ke logon main ne dushman ka lashkar apni ankhon se dekha hai dekho hoshyar ho jao bachne aur halak na hone ke saman kar lo. Ab kuch log us ki baat maan lete hain aur usi arse mein chal parte hain aur dushman ke panje se bach jate hain lekin baaz log use jhootha samajhte hain aur wahin be-fikri se pare rehte hain ke nagah dushman ka lashkar aa pahuncha hai aur gher ghaar kar unhe qatl kar deta hai pas yeh hai misal mere manne walon ki aur na manne walon ki. 

In logon ne Allah ki un kitabon ko jo un par utri thin para para kar diya jis masle ko ji chaha mana jis se dil ghabraya chhor diya. Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke is se murad Ahl-e-Kitab hain ke kitab ke baaz hisse ko mante the aur baaz ko nahi mante the. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke murad is se kuffar ka Kitabullah ki nisbat yeh kehna hai ke yeh jadoo hai, yeh kahanat hai, yeh aglon ki kahani hai, is ka kehne wala jadugar hai, majnoon hai, kahin hai waghera. 

Seerat Ibn Ishaq mein hai ke Waleed bin Mughira ke pas sardaran-e-Quresh jama hue Hajj ka mausam qareeb tha aur yeh shakhs un mein bara sharif aur zi-raye samjha jata tha us ne un sab se kaha ke dekho Hajj ke mauqe par door daraz se tamam Arab yahan jama honge. Tum dekh rahe ho ke tumhare is sathi ne ek audham macha rakha hai lehaza is ki nisbat un beroni logon se kya kaha jaye yeh batao aur kisi ek baat par ijma kar lo ke sab wahi kahein. Aisa na ho koi kuch kahe koi kuch kahe is se to tumhara etebar uth jaye ga aur woh pardesi tumhe jhootha khayal karenge. Unhon ne kaha Abu Abd Shams aap hi koi aisi baat tajwez kar dijiye us ne kaha pehle tum apni to kaho taake mujhe bhi ghor-o-khawz ka mauqa mile unhon ne kaha phir hamari raye mein to har shakhs use kahin batlaye. Us ne kaha yeh to waqiye ke khilaf hai logon ne kaha phir majnoon bilkul durust hai.

Us ne kaha yeh bhi ghalat hai, kaha acha to shair kahein? Us ne jawab diya ke woh shair jaanta hi nahi, kaha acha phir jaado-gar kahein? Kaha isay jaado se mass bhi nahi, us ne kaha suno Wallah is ke qaul mein ajab mithaas hai, in baaton mein se tum jo kahogay dunya samajh legi ke mahz ghalat aur safaid jhoot hai. Go koi baat nahi banti lekin kuch kehna zaroori hai, acha bhai sab isay jaado-gar batlayein. Is amr par yeh majma' barkhast huwa aur isi ka zikr in aayaton mein hai. Roz-e-Qayamat aik aik cheez ka sawal hoga, un ke amaal ka sawal un se un ka Rab zaroor karega yaani kalima La ilaha illallah se. Ibn Mas'ood (R.H) farmatay hain: Us Allah ki qasam jis ke siva koi mabood nahi ke tum mein se har aik shakhs qayamat ke din tanha tanha Allah ke saamne paish hoga jaise har aik shakhs chaudahween raat ke chaand ko akela akela dekhta hai. Allah farmayega: Aye insan! Tu mujh se maghroor kyun ho gaya? Tu ne apne ilm par kahan tak amal kiya? Tu ne mere rasoolon ko kya jawab diya? Abu Aliyah farmatay hain: Do cheezon ka sawal har aik se hoga, mabood kise bana rakha tha aur rasool ki maani ya nahi? Ibn Uyainah (R.H) farmatay hain: Amal aur maal ka sawal hoga. Hazrat Mu'az (R.H) se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Aye Mu'az! Insan se qayamat ke din har aik amal ka sawal hoga, yahan tak ke us ke aankh ke surmay aur us ke haath ki gandhi hui mitti ke baare mein bhi is se sawal hoga, dekh Mu'az! Aisa na ho ke qayamat ke din Allah ki neamton ke baare mein tu kami wala reh jaye. Is aayat mein to hai ke har aik se us ke amal ki baabat sawal hoga, aur Surah Rahman ki aayat mein hai ke aayat (Fayawma'izin la yus'alu 'an zambihii insun wa la jann) [55. Ar-Rahman: 39] ke us din kisi insan ya jinn se us ke gunahon ka sawal na hoga. In dono aayaton mein ba-qaul Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.H) tatbeeq yeh hai ke yeh sawal na hoga ke tu ne yeh amal kiya? Balkah yeh sawal hoga ke kyun kiya?

Rasool Allah ﷺ ke mukhalifin ka ibratnak anjam. Hukam ho raha hai ke aye Rasool Allah ﷺ aap Allah ki baatein logon ko saaf saaf be-jhijhak pohcha dein na kisi ki ro- رعایت (ro-riayat) kijiye na kisi ka dar khof kijiye. Is ayat ke utarne se pehle tak Huzoor ﷺ poshida tabligh farmate thay lekin iske baad aap aur aap ke ashab ne khule taur par ishaat-e-deen shuru kardi. In mazaq udane walon ko hum par chhor de hum khud in se nimt lenge to apni tabligh ke farize mein kotahi na kar yeh to chahte hain ke zara si susti aap ki taraf se dekhen to khud bhi dast-bardar hojayen. To in se mutlaqan khof na kar Allah Ta'ala teri jaanib utara gaya logon ki burai se tujhe mehfooz rakh lega. Chunacha ek din Huzoor ﷺ raste se ja rahe thay ke baaz mushrikin ne aap ko chheda usi waqt Hazrat Jibreel Alaihis Salam aaye aur unhe nishtar mara jis ke jismon mein aisa hogaya jaise neze ke zakhm hon usi mein woh margaye aur yeh log mushrikin ke bare bare ruasa thay. Badi umar ke thay aur nihayat sharif gine jate thay. Banu Asad ke qabeele mein to Aswad bin Abdul Muttalib Abu Zam'ah. Yeh Huzoor ﷺ ka bada hi dushman tha, ezayein diya karta tha aur mazaq udaya karta tha aap ne tang aakar iske liye bad-dua bhi ki thi ke aye Allah isse andha karde be-awlad karde. Bani Zuhrah mein se Aswad tha aur Bani Makhzoom mein se Waleed tha aur Bani Sahm mein se Aas bin Wail tha. Aur Khuza'ah mein se Haris tha. Yeh log barabar Huzoor ﷺ ko ezah-resai ke dar-pey lage rehte thay aur logon ko aap ke khilaf ubhara karte thay aur jo takleef inke bas mein hoti aap ko pohchaya karte jab yeh apne mazalim mein had se guzar gaye aur baat baat mein Huzoor ﷺ ka mazaq udane lage to Allah Ta'ala ne ayat (Fasda' bima tumaru... fa-in-ni min al-mushrikin) ya (Fasda' bima tumaru wa a'rid 'anil-mushrikin, inna kafaynakal-mustahzi'in, alladhina yaj'aluna ma'allahi ilahan akhar, fa-sawfa ya'lamun) tak ki ayatein nazil farmayen. Kehte hain ke Huzoor ﷺ tawaf kar rahe thay ke Hazrat Jibreel Alaihis Salam aaye Baitullah Sharif mein aap ke paas khade hogaye itne mein Aswad bin Abd Yaghus aap ke paas se guzra to Hazrat Jibreel Alaihis Salam ne iske pet ki taraf ishara kiya isse pet ki bimari hogayi aur usi mein woh mara. Itne mein Waleed bin Mughirah guzra iski edi ek Khuza'i shakhs ke teer ke phal se kuch yunhi si chhal gayi thi aur isse bhi do saal guzar chuke thay Hazrat Jibreel Alaihis Salam ne usi ki taraf ishara kiya woh phool gayi, paki aur usi mein woh mara. Phir Aas bin Wail guzra. Iske talwe ki taraf ishara kiya kuch dinon baad yeh Taif jane ke liye apne gadhe par sawar chala. Raste mein gir pada aur talwe mein keel ghus gayi jis ne iski jaan li. Haris ke sar ki taraf ishara kiya isse khoon aane laga aur usi mein mara. In sab moziyon ko sardar Waleed bin Mughirah tha isi ne inhein jama kiya tha pas yeh paanch ya saat shakhsh thay jo jad thay aur inke isharon se aur zaleel log bhi kamina-pan ki harkatein karte rehte thay. Yeh log is laghwo harkat ke sath hi yeh bhi karte thay ke Allah ke sath dusron ko shareek karte thay. Inhein apne kartoot ka maza abhi abhi ajayega. Aur bhi jo Rasool ka mukhalif ho Allah ke sath shirk kare iska yahi haal hai.

Humain khoob maloom hai ki un ki bakwaas se, ae Nabi ﷺ! tumhe takleef hoti hai, dil tang hota hai lekin tum un ka khayal bhi na karo. Allah tumhara madadgaar rahe. Tum apne Rab ke zikr aur us ki tasbeeh aur hamad mein lage raho. Us ki ibadat jee bhar kar karo, namaz ka khayal rakho, sajda karne walon ka sath do. Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ka irshad hai ke ae Ibne Adam! shuru din ki chaar rakaat se aajiz na ho, main tujhe aakhir din tak kifayat karunga. Huzoor ﷺ ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ki jab koi ghabraahat ka mamla aapadta to aap namaz shuru kar dete. 

Yaqeen ka mafhoom: Yaqeen se murad is aakhiri aayat mein maut hai. Is ki daleel Surah Muddassir ki woh aayatein hain jin mein bayaan hai ki jannami apni buraiyan karte hue kahenge ke hum namazi na the, maskino ko khana khilate na the, baatein banaya karte the aur qayamat ko jhutlate the, yahan tak ke maut aa gayi. Yahan bhi maut ki jagah lafz "yaqeen" hai. 

Ek sahih hadith mein bhi hai ke Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon ؓ ke inteqal ke baad jab Huzoor ﷺ un ke paas gaye to Ansar ki ek aurat Umm-ul-Ala ne kaha ke ae Abus Saib! Allah ki tujh par rehmaten hon, beshak Allah Ta'ala ne teri takreem aur izzat ki. Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh sun kar farmaya: Tujhe kaise yaqeen ho gaya ki Allah ne is ka ikraam kiya? Unhon ne jawab diya ke aap par mere maa-baap qurban hon, phir kaun hoga jis ka ikraam ho? Aap ne farmaya: Suno! Use maut aa chuki aur mujhe is ke liye bhalayi ki umeed hai. Is hadith mein bhi maut ki jagah yaqeen ka lafz hai. 

Is aayat se istedlal kiya hai ke namaz waghera ibadatein insan par farz hain jab tak ke us ki aql baqi rahe aur hosh o hawas sabit hon, jaisi us ki halat ho usi ke mutabiq namaz ada kar le. Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ki khade ho kar namaz ada kar, na ho sake toh baith kar, na ho sake toh karwat par lait kar. 

Bad-mazhabon ne is se apne matlab ki ek baat ghad li hai ki jab tak insan darja-e-kamal tak na pahunche us par ibadatein farz rehti hain lekin jab ma'rifat ki manzilein tay kar chuka toh ibadat ki takleef saqit ho jati hai. Yeh sarasar kufr, zalaalat aur jahalat hai. Yeh log itna nahi samjhte ki Anbiya aur Huzoor Sarwar-e-Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) aur aap ke ashab ma'rifat ke tamam darje tay kar chuke the aur deen ke ilm o irfan mein sab dunya se kamil the, Rab ki sifaat aur zaat ka sab se zyada ilm rakhte the, bawajood is ke sab se zyada Allah ki ibadat karte the aur Rab ki ita'at mein tamam dunya se zyada mashghool rehte the aur dunya ke aakhiri dam tak usi mein lage rahe. 

Pas sabit hai ki yahan murad yaqeen se maut hai. Tamam mufassireen, sahabah, tabai'n waghera ka yahi mazhab hai. Fa Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ka shukr o ehsan hai, us ne jo hume hidayat ata farmaayi hai us par hum us ki tareefen karte hain, usi se naik kaamon mein madad pate hain, usi ki pak zaat par hamara bharosa hai. Hum us Malik o Hakim se dua karte hain ke woh behtareen aur kamil Islam, iman aur neki par maut de, woh Jawwad hai aur Kareem hai.

Alhamdulillah Surah Hijr ki tafsir khatam hui, Allah Ta'ala qabul farmaye, wal-hamdu lillahi Rabbil 'alamin.

In sab moziyon ko sardar Waleed bin Mughirah tha isi ne inhein jama kiya tha pas yeh paanch ya saat shakhsh thay jo jad thay aur inke isharon se aur zaleel log bhi kamina-pan ki harkatein karte rehte thay. Yeh log is laghwo harkat ke sath hi yeh bhi karte thay ke Allah ke sath dusron ko shareek karte thay. Inhein apne kartoot ka maza abhi abhi ajayega. Aur bhi jo Rasool ka mukhalif ho Allah ke sath shirk kare iska yahi haal hai.

Humain khoob maloom hai ki un ki bakwaas se, ae Nabi ﷺ! tumhe takleef hoti hai, dil tang hota hai lekin tum un ka khayal bhi na karo. Allah tumhara madadgaar rahe. Tum apne Rab ke zikr aur us ki tasbeeh aur hamad mein lage raho. Us ki ibadat jee bhar kar karo, namaz ka khayal rakho, sajda karne walon ka sath do. Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ka irshad hai ke ae Ibne Adam! shuru din ki chaar rakaat se aajiz na ho, main tujhe aakhir din tak kifayat karunga. Huzoor ﷺ ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ki jab koi ghabraahat ka mamla aapadta to aap namaz shuru kar dete. 

Yaqeen ka mafhoom: Yaqeen se murad is aakhiri aayat mein maut hai. Is ki daleel Surah Muddassir ki woh aayatein hain jin mein bayaan hai ki jannami apni buraiyan karte hue kahenge ke hum namazi na the, maskino ko khana khilate na the, baatein banaya karte the aur qayamat ko jhutlate the, yahan tak ke maut aa gayi. Yahan bhi maut ki jagah lafz "yaqeen" hai. 

Ek sahih hadith mein bhi hai ke Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon ؓ ke inteqal ke baad jab Huzoor ﷺ un ke paas gaye to Ansar ki ek aurat Umm-ul-Ala ne kaha ke ae Abus Saib! Allah ki tujh par rehmaten hon, beshak Allah Ta'ala ne teri takreem aur izzat ki. Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh sun kar farmaya: Tujhe kaise yaqeen ho gaya ki Allah ne is ka ikraam kiya? Unhon ne jawab diya ke aap par mere maa-baap qurban hon, phir kaun hoga jis ka ikraam ho? Aap ne farmaya: Suno! Use maut aa chuki aur mujhe is ke liye bhalayi ki umeed hai. Is hadith mein bhi maut ki jagah yaqeen ka lafz hai. 

Is aayat se istedlal kiya hai ke namaz waghera ibadatein insan par farz hain jab tak ke us ki aql baqi rahe aur hosh o hawas sabit hon, jaisi us ki halat ho usi ke mutabiq namaz ada kar le. Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ki khade ho kar namaz ada kar, na ho sake toh baith kar, na ho sake toh karwat par lait kar. 

Bad-mazhabon ne is se apne matlab ki ek baat ghad li hai ki jab tak insan darja-e-kamal tak na pahunche us par ibadatein farz rehti hain lekin jab ma'rifat ki manzilein tay kar chuka toh ibadat ki takleef saqit ho jati hai. Yeh sarasar kufr, zalaalat aur jahalat hai. Yeh log itna nahi samjhte ki Anbiya aur Huzoor Sarwar-e-Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) aur aap ke ashab ma'rifat ke tamam darje tay kar chuke the aur deen ke ilm o irfan mein sab dunya se kamil the, Rab ki sifaat aur zaat ka sab se zyada ilm rakhte the, bawajood is ke sab se zyada Allah ki ibadat karte the aur Rab ki ita'at mein tamam dunya se zyada mashghool rehte the aur dunya ke aakhiri dam tak usi mein lage rahe. 

Pas sabit hai ki yahan murad yaqeen se maut hai. Tamam mufassireen, sahabah, tabai'n waghera ka yahi mazhab hai. Fa Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ka shukr o ehsan hai, us ne jo hume hidayat ata farmaayi hai us par hum us ki tareefen karte hain, usi se naik kaamon mein madad pate hain, usi ki pak zaat par hamara bharosa hai. Hum us Malik o Hakim se dua karte hain ke woh behtareen aur kamil Islam, iman aur neki par maut de, woh Jawwad hai aur Kareem hai.

Alhamdulillah Surah Hijr ki tafsir khatam hui, Allah Ta'ala qabul farmaye, wal-hamdu lillahi Rabbil 'alamin.

Rasool Allah ﷺ ke mukhalifin ka ibratnak anjam. Hukam ho raha hai ke aye Rasool Allah ﷺ aap Allah ki baatein logon ko saaf saaf be-jhijhak pohcha dein na kisi ki ro- رعایت (ro-riayat) kijiye na kisi ka dar khof kijiye. Is ayat ke utarne se pehle tak Huzoor ﷺ poshida tabligh farmate thay lekin iske baad aap aur aap ke ashab ne khule taur par ishaat-e-deen shuru kardi. In mazaq udane walon ko hum par chhor de hum khud in se nimt lenge to apni tabligh ke farize mein kotahi na kar yeh to chahte hain ke zara si susti aap ki taraf se dekhen to khud bhi dast-bardar hojayen. To in se mutlaqan khof na kar Allah Ta'ala teri jaanib utara gaya logon ki burai se tujhe mehfooz rakh lega. Chunacha ek din Huzoor ﷺ raste se ja rahe thay ke baaz mushrikin ne aap ko chheda usi waqt Hazrat Jibreel Alaihis Salam aaye aur unhe nishtar mara jis ke jismon mein aisa hogaya jaise neze ke zakhm hon usi mein woh margaye aur yeh log mushrikin ke bare bare ruasa thay. Badi umar ke thay aur nihayat sharif gine jate thay. Banu Asad ke qabeele mein to Aswad bin Abdul Muttalib Abu Zam'ah. Yeh Huzoor ﷺ ka bada hi dushman tha, ezayein diya karta tha aur mazaq udaya karta tha aap ne tang aakar iske liye bad-dua bhi ki thi ke aye Allah isse andha karde be-awlad karde. Bani Zuhrah mein se Aswad tha aur Bani Makhzoom mein se Waleed tha aur Bani Sahm mein se Aas bin Wail tha. Aur Khuza'ah mein se Haris tha. Yeh log barabar Huzoor ﷺ ko ezah-resai ke dar-pey lage rehte thay aur logon ko aap ke khilaf ubhara karte thay aur jo takleef inke bas mein hoti aap ko pohchaya karte jab yeh apne mazalim mein had se guzar gaye aur baat baat mein Huzoor ﷺ ka mazaq udane lage to Allah Ta'ala ne ayat (Fasda' bima tumaru... fa-in-ni min al-mushrikin) ya (Fasda' bima tumaru wa a'rid 'anil-mushrikin, inna kafaynakal-mustahzi'in, alladhina yaj'aluna ma'allahi ilahan akhar, fa-sawfa ya'lamun) tak ki ayatein nazil farmayen. Kehte hain ke Huzoor ﷺ tawaf kar rahe thay ke Hazrat Jibreel Alaihis Salam aaye Baitullah Sharif mein aap ke paas khade hogaye itne mein Aswad bin Abd Yaghus aap ke paas se guzra to Hazrat Jibreel Alaihis Salam ne iske pet ki taraf ishara kiya isse pet ki bimari hogayi aur usi mein woh mara. Itne mein Waleed bin Mughirah guzra iski edi ek Khuza'i shakhs ke teer ke phal se kuch yunhi si chhal gayi thi aur isse bhi do saal guzar chuke thay Hazrat Jibreel Alaihis Salam ne usi ki taraf ishara kiya woh phool gayi, paki aur usi mein woh mara.
